title: Lead Financial Analyst
description:
We are looking for a talented Lead Financial Analyst to join our dynamic team at CVS Health. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work

- Strong proficiency in Stakeholder Management, Tableau, Communication, Problem Solving
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of $120,000 – $160,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Join Block (Square) as a Staff Software Engineer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Staff Software Engineer with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Staff Software Engineer or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Git, Kubernetes, Leadership, Microservices
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: $160,000 – $200,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

- Competitive salary of $80,000 – $120,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

description:

title: Mid-Level Mechanical Engineer
description:
JetBlue is seeking a Mid-Level Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Mid-Level Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**

- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

- 9+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Project Management, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Problem Solving
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: $80,000 – $120,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Principal Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
Discount Tire is seeking a Principal Embedded Systems Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Embedded Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 8+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Agile, CI/CD, Microsoft Office, React
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: $50,000 – $80,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Director of Electrical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Director of Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic team at Chicago Bulls. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 6 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Team Management, Leadership
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of $50,000 – $80,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
